description: This file defines the AlertsViewDefault class, which extends SugarView, and handles displaying alert views in the SuiteCRM application. It sets a module title parameter and renders a template with JSON configuration variables.

classes.name: AlertsViewDefault
classes.description: A view class extending SugarView, responsible for rendering the alerts JSON view.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameter array, setting 'Alerts' as the title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Fetches JSON configuration variables and renders the json.tpl template, then terminates execution.
